**Main line:** 1...f5+ 2.Ke5 (or any king move) Rxa7, winning the rook (or in case of Kxf5, Black still plays Rxa7).

---

**Coaching Note:**

When you move a piece to give check, look for a hidden threat it uncovers. Here, f5+ forces the king away while simultaneously attacking White's undefended rook on a7. Your rook on g7 was already lined up behind Black's f7 pawn, aimed right at White's rook. Moving f5+ removes the blocker and gives check at the same time—a discovered attack. Always scan the board after giving check to find pieces your move just exposed.
